note: Conceptual lesson on structuring and presenting an integration architecture design for a review board (business context, decisions/alternatives, design, risks/mitigations, assumptions; requirements traceability; review-ready diagram scope). No screenshots per this course's conceptual/architecture policy. This lesson teaches general, well-established CTA-style review-board presentation practice and applies it to Doverfield's existing, already-sourced case studies; no new vendor-specific feature claims are introduced that require fresh verification.
